svg.title: Stonehallow - Crownhold
svg.text: Numbers on the plan = building ID (C-####).
W x D = footprint in metres; WALL = wall height
above the highest ground under the building.
Crag plateau at 118 m, cliffs to the north.
Outer curtain 18 m high, 5 m thick, 13 towers;
inner curtain 24 m with 7 towers. Keep 46 m.
ID NAME W x D WALL ROOF FL
0028 Great Hall of the Kings 52x18 18m gable 1
0029 Royal Chapel of St. Stephen 32x13 16m gable 1
0033 Barracks of the King's Guard 70x13 9m gable 2
